plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the Slack marketing site, focusing on the pricing decision flow, feature discovery, and conversion paths (Sign Up/Sales), while validating mobile responsiveness against known layout warnings.
plan.summary: The run will begin by validating the primary navigation and hero section on the homepage. It will then dive deep into the Pricing page to test plan comparison logic and billing toggles. Subsequent phases will cover Feature discovery, Enterprise/Trust validation, and the 'Talk to Sales' lead generation form. The run concludes with a mobile viewport pass to verify tap targets flagged in the prescan.
assumptions: The 'Get started free' flow leads to a functional email capture or OAuth simulation on get-started.html.
The 'Talk to sales' form on contact.html accepts dummy data for submission testing.
Anchor links on features.html (e.g., #channels) correctly scroll to or display specific module details.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html: Monthly/Annual toggle state persistence and price updates.
pricing.html: Feature comparison table readability and alignment.
contact.html: Form validation errors and required field handling.
Mobile Viewport: Navigation menu accessibility and small tap targets (identified in prescan).

phases.title: Homepage & Navigation Baseline
phases.objective: Validate global navigation consistency and primary hero CTAs.
key_checks: Verify all top-level nav links (Features, Solutions, Enterprise, Pricing) resolve correctly.
Test 'Get started free' CTA redirection to get-started.html.
Test 'Talk to sales' CTA redirection to contact.html.
Scroll through product modules (Channels, AI, Automation) to check for lazy-loading issues or broken animations.

phases.title: Pricing Logic & Comparison
phases.objective: Deep dive into the pricing structure, toggles, and plan differentiation.
key_checks: Toggle between 'Monthly' and 'Annual' billing; verify price updates and discount messaging.
Scan the feature comparison table for visual alignment and clarity.
Click 'Get started free' under different tiers to ensure consistent redirection.
Check FAQ accordion interactions for expand/collapse functionality.
exit_criteria: Billing toggle state changes reflected in UI.

phases.title: Feature Discovery & Enterprise Trust
phases.objective: Explore detailed feature pages and enterprise-specific trust signals.
key_checks: On features.html: Click category tabs (Collaboration, Project Management, etc.) to filter content.
Test anchor links from index.html (e.g., 'Learn more about Channels') land on correct sections.
On enterprise.html: Verify security badges and compliance info visibility.
On trust.html: Check for clear hierarchy of security information.

phases.title: Conversion Flows (Sales & Sign Up)
phases.objective: Test the lead generation and account creation forms.
key_checks: On contact.html: Fill out 'Talk to sales' form with valid dummy data; test submit behavior.
On contact.html: Attempt submit with missing required fields to check validation UI.
On get-started.html: Test email input and 'Continue' button.
On signin.html: Verify 'Forgot password' and SSO options (Google/Microsoft) are present.
exit_criteria: Success state or next step visible on valid submission.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks on mobile viewport to address prescan warnings.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport (e.g., iPhone SE/Pixel 5).
Verify hamburger menu opens and closes correctly.
Re-test tap targets for Nav links and Pricing toggles (previously flagged as <44px).
Ensure pricing tables stack or scroll horizontally without breaking layout.
Check form inputs on contact.html for zoom/focus issues.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise billing toggles, feature filters, form validations, and accordions.
coverage_targets.mobile: Full pass on Homepage, Pricing, and Contact pages.

notes: Prescan identified multiple 'small_tap_target' warnings on index.html; prioritize checking these in Phase 5.
No backend connectivity is expected; focus on frontend UI states and redirection logic.
Keep an eye on the 'AI' feature mentions across pages to ensure consistent messaging.

prescan_summary.title: Trust & Security – Slack
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free Trust & Security Security isn't just a feature — it's the foundation of everything we build. Data Encryption All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Your conversations and files are protected at every layer. Compliance Certifications Slack maintains SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and CSA certifications. We also support HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance. Enterprise Key Management Control your own encryption keys with Slack EKM, powered by AWS KMS. Revoke access to data at any time with full audit trails. Data Loss Prevention Native DLP scans messages and files in Slack Connect to prevent sharing of confidential, malicious or personally identifiable content. Identity & Access SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, two-factor authentication, session management
